launch.rosparam: sensors: - sensor_plugin: occupancy_map_monitor/PointCloudOctomapUpdater point_cloud_topic: /camera/depth/points max_range: 2.0 # min_range: drop depth samples closer than this. Critical for # eye-in-hand cameras: when the wrist gets within ~25cm of the # target, the body fills the camera FOV and gets re-projected # into octomap voxels right next to the camera_mount link, # producing spurious "self-collisions" that abort approach # trajectories. 0.30m keeps everything during free navigation # (camera typically >40cm from objects) and stops false alarms # during scan approach. min_range: 0.30 point_subsample: 1 padding_offset: 0.1 padding_scale: 1.0 filtered_cloud_topic: /move_group/filtered_cloud
